items.title: Last Leaves Run
items.summary: One more run before the gates close for winter. Peak color, a pondside camp, and a kamayan-style breakfast on Sunday.

items.title: Breakneck at Sunrise
items.summary: Headlamps on, scramble up, watch the sun hit the Hudson. Coffee and pandesal at the top.

items.title: Rausch Creek Trail Day
items.location: Rausch Creek Off-Road Park, Pine Grove PA
items.summary: Split groups by build: stock rigs on the greens with a spotter, built rigs on the reds. Nobody is left behind on the trail.

items.title: Friendsgiving Salu-Salo
items.summary: Potluck, parking lot rig show and raffle. Bring a dish from home, whether that is lumpia, pancit or your tita's leche flan. Families welcome.

items.title: Recovery 101 Clinic
items.location: Smith Point County Park, Shirley NY
items.summary: Hands-on practice with traction boards, kinetic ropes, soft shackles and winching. You will get stuck on purpose and get yourself out.

items.title: Simbang Gabi Night Convoy
items.location: Meet in Woodside, Queens, then roll out
items.summary: A lit-up convoy through the city, then Simbang Gabi mass and bibingka and puto bumbong after. Parol lights on rigs are encouraged.
bring: Parol or string lights for your rig

items.title: Pine Barrens Sand Run
items.location: Batsto Village, Wharton State Forest NJ
items.summary: A first-timer friendly winter run. We will teach airing down, sand driving and route reading.

items.title: Spring Thaw Boodle Fight
items.location: Smith Point Outer Beach, Long Island
items.summary: Beach run, then a boodle fight: rice, inihaw and ensalada on banana leaves, eaten kamayan style. The first big run of the season.
